intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an outdoor sunrise yoga session along the scenic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud, surrounded by lush jungle and rice paddies. Many local instructors offer small group sessions here, combining gentle movement with breathtaking natural views to start your day mindfully.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf
experiences.description: Spend an afternoon at the famous Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful stretches of golden sand. Take a beginner-friendly surf lesson with a local instructor, then relax and watch the legendary Bali sunset over the Indian Ocean. Surf rentals and lessons are widely available along the beach.

experiences.name: Multi-Day Yoga Retreat at The Yoga Barn
experiences.description: Attend multiple drop-in yoga and meditation classes at The Yoga Barn, one of Bali's most renowned wellness centers. With a wide variety of styles including Hatha, Vinyasa, and Yin, this is a spiritual and physical highlight for any yoga enthusiast visiting Ubud. Drop-in rates make it flexible for your schedule.

experiences.name: Snorkeling at Nusa Lembongan
experiences.description: Take a short boat ride from Sanur to the island of Nusa Lembongan for a half-day snorkeling tour. Explore vibrant coral reefs, swim with tropical fish, and if lucky, spot manta rays in the crystal-clear waters. The island also offers stunning white sand beaches perfect for relaxing after your snorkel adventure.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Ubud Market Tour
experiences.description: Begin with an early morning guided tour of the vibrant Ubud Traditional Market to select fresh local ingredients, then head to a family-run cooking school to prepare authentic Balinese dishes such as satay lilit, nasi goreng, and black rice pudding. A delicious cultural immersion that connects food, tradition, and community.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, clear customs and immigration. Take a pre-booked budget shuttle or shared Grab car to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud (~1.5–2 hrs). Check in to Campuhan Ridge Ubud Boutique Stay, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk to stretch your legs after the flight — a free, scenic trail through lush green hills.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the quiet lanes around Campuhan and Jalan Raya Ubud. Visit the nearby Pura Gunung Lebah temple at sunset for a peaceful introduction to Balinese culture. Head to a warung (local eatery) on Jalan Raya Campuhan for a simple first dinner.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the airport or on the plane before arrival.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport or a roadside warung near Ubud on arrival — try nasi goreng (fried rice) for ~IDR 20,000–35,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka or a local warung near Campuhan — mixed rice plate (nasi campur) for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.

day_by_day.notes: Use Grab app for affordable transport from the airport. Avoid metered taxis — negotiate fixed fares or use ride-hailing apps. Exchange some cash to IDR at the airport for small purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Join a free or donation-based morning yoga class at one of Ubud's community yoga spaces or the Yoga Barn's introductory session (~IDR 100,000–130,000). The warm summer weather makes early morning practice (~7:00–9:00 AM) ideal before the heat builds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk the Campuhan Ridge Walk in full — the 9 km round-trip trail is completely free and offers stunning panoramic views of rice paddies and jungle. Carry a reusable water bottle. Return by early afternoon and visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum (~IDR 50,000) nearby for art inspiration.
day_by_day.evening: Browse the Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni Ubud) for souvenirs and local handicrafts — great for bargaining. Watch a traditional Kecak or Legong dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud (~IDR 80,000–100,000) in the evening.

meals.breakfast: Warung or guesthouse breakfast — banana pancakes and fresh juice at a local café for ~IDR 30,000–50,000.
meals.lunch: Picnic-style snacks from the morning market or a warung along the ridge walk — fresh fruit, tempe, and rice cakes.
meals.dinner: Warung Teges or a local nasi campur spot near Ubud center — ~IDR 30,000–50,000 per meal.

day_by_day.notes: The Campuhan Ridge Walk is best done early morning or late afternoon to avoid midday heat. Wear sunscreen and light clothing. July is dry season in Bali — only 30mm of rain expected, so outdoor activities are very reliable.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for sunrise yoga or meditation at The Yoga Barn (~IDR 120,000 per class) — one of Bali's most beloved yoga studios, just a short walk or cheap ojek (motorbike taxi) ride from Campuhan. Choose a hatha or vinyasa flow class.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple (~IDR 50,000 entry + sarong rental ~IDR 15,000), a stunning Hindu water temple where locals and visitors participate in ritual purification bathing. Take a shared tourist shuttle (~IDR 50,000 round trip) or rent a scooter (~IDR 70,000/day) to get there.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud and enjoy a leisurely walk through the Monkey Forest Road area. Dine at a budget-friendly restaurant on Jalan Hanoman. Catch the golden hour light over the rice terraces near the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit bowl and black coffee at a local warung near Campuhan — ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Tirta Empul — gado-gado (peanut sauce salad) or soto ayam (chicken soup) for ~IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Rai on Monkey Forest Road — traditional Balinese rijsttafel-style meal for ~IDR 45,000–70,000.

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly at Tirta Empul — shoulders and knees must be covered. Sarongs are available for rent at the entrance. If renting a scooter, carry your passport and an international driving permit.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Tegalalang Rice Terraces (~IDR 10,000–15,000 donation entry) — one of Bali's most photogenic spots. Go early (~7:30 AM) before tour groups arrive. Walk the terraced paths and enjoy the cool morning air. Located ~10 km north of Ubud — take an ojek for ~IDR 30,000 each way.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue north to visit the Kanto Lampo Waterfall (~IDR 10,000 entry) or Tibumana Waterfall (~IDR 20,000) for a refreshing swim in natural pools. The warm 25°C weather is perfect for waterfall visits. Bring a change of clothes.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud by late afternoon. Treat yourself to a budget Balinese massage on Jalan Hanoman (~IDR 80,000–100,000 for 60 min). Enjoy a quiet dinner near the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Warung breakfast near Campuhan — nasi goreng with egg and tea for ~IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Local warung near Tegalalang — mixed rice and vegetables for ~IDR 20,000–35,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Sopa on Jalan Sueta — vegetarian Balinese food, budget-friendly at ~IDR 40,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: Negotiate ojek fares before departure. The waterfalls involve short hikes on rocky terrain — wear appropriate footwear. Bring cash as many rural spots don't accept cards.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga flow at The Yoga Barn or a free outdoor session on the hotel grounds / Campuhan Ridge. Spend the rest of the morning exploring the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — free to enter during the day — and the surrounding streets of central Ubud.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Ubud Traditional Market (Pasar Ubud) for fresh produce, local snacks, and handmade goods. Then head to the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (~IDR 80,000 entry) — a lush nature reserve home to hundreds of Balinese long-tailed macaques and ancient temples.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free or low-cost community event — check noticeboards at The Yoga Barn or Bali Spirit for workshops or kirtan evenings. Enjoy a relaxed dinner on Jalan Dewi Sita.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl or avocado toast at a budget café near Campuhan — ~IDR 35,000–55,000.
meals.lunch: Snack on fresh fruit and local sweets from Ubud Market — ~IDR 15,000–25,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Bernadette or similar local spot — nasi campur and fresh coconut for ~IDR 35,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: At the Monkey Forest, keep bags zipped and remove sunglasses — monkeys are known to grab shiny objects. Don't feed the monkeys with outside food.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day to the coast — take a shared tourist shuttle from Ubud to Seminyak or Canggu (~IDR 50,000–75,000 per person, ~1.5 hrs). Check in to a budget guesthouse or hostel in Canggu (pre-book a dorm or private room for ~IDR 150,000–250,000/night). Drop bags and head straight to the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at Echo Beach or Batu Bolong Beach in Canggu — both free to access. Swim, sunbathe, and watch local surfers ride the waves. Rent a surfboard for ~IDR 50,000–75,000/hr if interested in trying surfing. The warm 25°C weather and July dry season make this perfect beach weather.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the spectacular Canggu sunset from the beach — one of Bali's finest. Explore the Canggu beach strip and enjoy a casual beachside dinner.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at Ubud before departure — local warung nasi goreng for ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Grab a cheap warungnear Batu Bolong Beach — fresh fish with rice for ~IDR 35,000–55,000.
meals.dinner: Old Man's Bar or a beachside warung in Canggu — grilled fish, rice, and a Bintang beer for ~IDR 60,000–90,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book the shuttle in advance from your hotel or a travel agent in Ubud. Canggu has a strong surf and yoga culture — great for meeting like-minded budget travelers.

day_by_day.morning: Join a sunrise beach yoga class on Batu Bolong Beach (~IDR 100,000–150,000) or find a free outdoor session posted on local noticeboards. Yoga in the open air with ocean views is a highlight of Canggu. Afterward, explore the famous Tanah Lot Temple (~IDR 60,000 entry) — a short 30-min drive from Canggu by scooter (~IDR 70,000/day rental).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Canggu and spend the afternoon beach-hopping — walk from Batu Bolong to Echo Beach along the shoreline. Swim and relax. Pop into a local surf shop or browse the hip boutiques along Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Echo Beach — famous for its dramatic rocky backdrop and large waves. Enjoy drinks and snacks at a beachside café. Explore Canggu's lively but affordable evening scene.

meals.breakfast: Warung breakfast near your guesthouse — banana pancakes and fresh juice for ~IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Tanah Lot — nasi campur or mie goreng for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Dandelion or a local spot in Canggu — mixed rice plate and fresh coconut water for ~IDR 40,000–65,000.

day_by_day.notes: Tanah Lot is most dramatic at low tide when you can walk across to the base of the rock. Check tide times before visiting. Wear a sarong — available for rent at the entrance.

day_by_day.morning: Travel from Canggu to Seminyak (~20 min by scooter or Grab, ~IDR 20,000–30,000). Walk along Seminyak Beach — a quieter, more upscale stretch than Kuta but still free to access. Enjoy the morning calm and warm ocean water. Try a free beach yoga stretch session on the sand.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Seminyak's famous Jalan Kayu Aya (Eat Street) — window-shop and browse local boutiques. Visit the Double Six Beach for afternoon swimming and people-watching. Rent a sun lounger for ~IDR 30,000–50,000 or lay on the free public beach.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Kuta Beach (15 min south by Grab) for one of Bali's most famous sunsets — completely free. Walk the busy Kuta strip and enjoy the lively atmosphere. Return to Seminyak for dinner.

meals.breakfast: Warung in Canggu before departure — nasi goreng and tea for ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Seminyak Beach — fresh grilled corn, satay skewers, and coconut for ~IDR 30,000–50,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Murah on Jalan Seminyak or a local spot off the main strip — local food for ~IDR 40,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: Seminyak has many overpriced tourist restaurants — stick to warungs and local spots one block back from the main beach road for budget meals. Grab is the most affordable transport option between beach towns.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to the Bukit Peninsula — take a Grab or shared shuttle (~IDR 100,000–150,000 round trip) to Uluwatu. Visit the clifftop Uluwatu Temple (~IDR 50,000 entry) perched dramatically 70m above the Indian Ocean. Explore the surrounding cliffs and ocean viewpoints.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend the cliff steps to Padang Padang Beach (~IDR 15,000 entry) — a stunning hidden cove beach beloved by surfers and beach lovers. Swim, sunbathe, and soak in the turquoise water. The July dry season guarantees clear skies and calm conditions.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the famous Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple at sunset (~IDR 100,000–150,000) — one of Bali's most spectacular cultural performances held on a clifftop stage with the ocean as a backdrop. Return to Seminyak or Canggu for the night.

meals.breakfast: Warung near your accommodation — fresh fruit platter and local coffee for ~IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.lunch: Warung at Padang Padang Beach — grilled fish and rice for ~IDR 35,000–55,000.
meals.dinner: Local warung back in Seminyak or Canggu — nasi campur for ~IDR 35,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Kecak Dance in advance or arrive at Uluwatu by 5:00 PM to secure a good seat. The performance starts around 6:00 PM. Keep your belongings close — monkeys at Uluwatu are notorious thieves.

day_by_day.morning: Return journey to Ubud — take a shared tourist shuttle from Seminyak/Canggu (~IDR 50,000–75,000, ~1.5 hrs). Check back in to Campuhan Ridge Ubud Boutique Stay. Enjoy a slow morning walk along the Campuhan Ridge after the coastal days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave Temple) (~IDR 50,000 entry + sarong ~IDR 15,000) — an 11th-century archaeological site with ancient cave carvings, meditation niches, and bathing pools. Located ~4 km from central Ubud — reach by scooter or ojek (~IDR 20,000).
day_by_day.evening: Attend a restorative or yin yoga class at The Yoga Barn (~IDR 120,000) to recover from the coastal days. Enjoy a quiet evening in Ubud's peaceful atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Quick warung breakfast before departure from Canggu/Seminyak — ~IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — local lunch for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Bebek Bengil (Dirty Duck Diner) — splurge slightly on crispy duck, a Ubud classic — ~IDR 80,000–120,000.

day_by_day.notes: Goa Gajah requires modest dress. The cave interior is small and atmospheric — bring a small torch/flashlight for a better look at the carvings. The bathing pools are beautifully restored.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning sunrise hike to Mount Batur volcano (~IDR 300,000–400,000 for a guided group trek including breakfast at the summit) — one of Bali's most iconic budget adventures. Depart from Ubud at ~2:00 AM to reach the summit for sunrise. The 2-hour climb rewards with panoramic views over Lake Batur and Mount Agung.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ubud by midday. Rest and recover at the hotel. Take a gentle afternoon walk through the rice paddies behind Campuhan Ridge — a free and meditative experience.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourself to a budget Balinese traditional massage (~IDR 80,000–100,000 for 60 min) at one of Ubud's many affordable spas on Jalan Hanoman. Early dinner and early bedtime to recover.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the summit of Mount Batur — included in the guided trek package (usually boiled eggs, toast, and hot drinks).
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a warung near Campuhan on return — fresh coconut and rice dishes for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung near the hotel — simple nasi campur and fresh juice for ~IDR 30,000–45,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Mount Batur trek through your hotel or a reputable local agency the day before. Bring warm layers — the summit temperature can drop to 10°C before sunrise despite warm daytime temperatures. Wear sturdy shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning yoga session at The Yoga Barn or a gentle walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk to say goodbye to Ubud's landscapes. Spend time journaling or meditating at a peaceful spot overlooking the valley.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore any remaining Ubud highlights — visit the Neka Art Museum (~IDR 75,000) for an overview of Balinese and Indonesian art, or browse the craft village of Celuk (silverwork) or Mas (woodcarving) by scooter. Do any final souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner in Ubud — splurge slightly on a nice restaurant or enjoy a final traditional Balinese meal at a well-loved local warung. Attend one last cultural performance if available. Pack and prepare for departure.

meals.breakfast: Warung breakfast near Campuhan — favorite local dish from the trip for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a café in central Ubud — gado-gado and fresh juice for ~IDR 35,000–55,000.
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at Warung Ibu Oka (famous babi guling — suckling pig) or a vegetarian splurge at Kafe Ubud — ~IDR 60,000–100,000.

day_by_day.notes: Check your flight details and arrange airport transport in advance — book a shuttle or Grab car for the next morning. Confirm your hotel checkout time. Exchange remaining IDR back to your home currency at a money changer in Ubud.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise over the Campuhan Ridge — wake up early for one last look at Ubud's magical landscape. Enjoy a slow breakfast and complete hotel checkout. Take a pre-arranged shuttle or Grab car to Ngurah Rai International Airport (~1.5–2 hrs from Ubud). Arrive at the airport with plenty of time before your flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure from Bali. Browse duty-free shops at the airport for any last-minute gifts. Reflect on 13 incredible days of beaches, yoga, culture, and adventure across Bali.
day_by_day.evening: In-flight or at transit destination.

meals.breakfast: Final warung breakfast near Campuhan — nasi goreng and Balinese coffee for ~IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Airport food or snacks — budget ~IDR 50,000–100,000 for a meal at the airport.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at transit airport.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for airport check-in and security at Ngurah Rai — the airport can be busy. Keep your passport, boarding pass, and any receipts for tax refunds easily accessible. Bali has a departure tax included in most international tickets.

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer from airport to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle orientation stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk to soak in the lush green hillside views and get your bearings
day_by_day.evening: Explore the nearby Jalan Raya Ubud strip, browse local art galleries, and settle into Ubud's relaxed evening vibe

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Skip or grab a light bite at the airport before departure
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go (Jalan Dewi Sita) — vibrant farm-to-table Indonesian cuisine, mid-range, great introduction to Ubud's food scene

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — rest and acclimatise. Bali is warm and humid; hydrate well after the flight. Exchange currency at the airport or use a local ATM in Ubud centre.

day_by_day.morning: Join a sunrise yoga class at Yoga Barn (Jalan Hanoman, ~15 min from hotel) — one of Bali's most celebrated yoga centres offering Hatha or Vinyasa sessions with stunning jungle backdrop
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary in central Ubud — walk through ancient temples and lush rainforest inhabited by long-tailed macaques. Then explore Ubud Art Market for local crafts and souvenirs
day_by_day.evening: Watch a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud — an unmissable cultural spectacle held at sunset

meals.breakfast: Sari Organik (Subak Sok Wayah) — wholesome organic smoothie bowls and eggs, set among rice terraces
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka — iconic Bali suckling pig (babi guling), a local institution, very affordable
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali (Campuhan) — elegant mid-range restaurant perched over the Wos River, excellent Indonesian and international menu

day_by_day.notes: Book Yoga Barn classes in advance online. Kecak Dance tickets (~IDR 100,000) can be purchased at the venue. Wear a sarong at temple sites.

day_by_day.morning: Morning meditation and pranayama session at The Yoga Barn or your hotel's wellness space. Afterward, take the Campuhan Ridge Walk at a leisurely pace — best in the cool morning hours with fewer crowds and golden light
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~20 min north of Ubud) — iconic UNESCO-listed stepped paddies. Walk the trails, interact with local farmers, and enjoy the scenic views. Optional: try a coconut at a roadside stall
day_by_day.evening: Stroll through central Ubud and browse independent galleries along Jalan Hanoman

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — excellent specialty coffee, avocado toast, and granola bowls in a stylish setting
meals.lunch: Warung Teges (near Tegallalang) — local warung with authentic nasi campur and grilled fish at very affordable prices
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique (splurge-worthy mid-range treat) — award-winning modern European-Balinese cuisine in a garden setting

day_by_day.notes: Hire a scooter (~IDR 70,000/day) or use a Grab car to reach Tegallalang. Bring sunscreen and a hat — the rice terraces are exposed to full sun.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Seminyak / Kuta beach area (~1.5 hrs by car). Start with a morning beach yoga session on Seminyak Beach or join a surf lesson for beginners at Kuta Beach — warm, calm July waves are ideal
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on Seminyak Beach, swim, and sunbathe. Explore the boutique shops and beach clubs along Jalan Kayu Aya (Eat Street)
day_by_day.evening: Catch the legendary Balinese sunset from Ku De Ta or La Plancha beach bar — colourful bean bags on the sand, cocktails in hand

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the hotel before departure
meals.lunch: Sisterfields Seminyak — popular café with excellent brunch plates, grain bowls, and fresh juices
meals.dinner: Merah Putih (Seminyak) — stunning two-storey restaurant serving refined Indonesian regional dishes in a dramatic architectural space

day_by_day.notes: Book a private driver for the day (~IDR 400,000–500,000) for comfort and flexibility. Seminyak is more upscale and relaxed than Kuta for beach time.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Tirta Empul Temple (~30 min from Ubud) — a sacred water purification temple where you can observe or participate in the traditional melukat cleansing ritual in the holy spring pools
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Kintamani for breathtaking panoramic views of Mount Batur volcano and Lake Batur. Optional: short hike around the crater rim area or visit the local market
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud and enjoy a traditional Balinese massage at a reputable spa near Campuhan Ridge

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel or grab a light meal before departing early
meals.lunch: Lakeview Restaurant, Kintamani — mid-range buffet with spectacular volcano views; a classic Bali tourist lunch stop
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka 3 (Ubud) or Nasi Ayam Kedewatan — hearty local Balinese dinner

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong and respectful clothing for Tirta Empul. The purification ritual is open to visitors with proper attire. Arrive early (7–8am) to beat the crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Yin Yoga or restorative yoga class at Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive studio in Ubud centre — a slower, meditative practice perfect for mid-trip recovery
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Ubud's museum quarter: visit the Neka Art Museum and ARMA (Agung Rai Museum of Art) to discover Balinese and Indonesian fine art and cultural heritage
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Legong or Barong dance performance at Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — held in a royal open-air courtyard

meals.breakfast: Clear Café (Jalan Hanoman) — extensive menu of healthy, organic, plant-based dishes and fresh juices
meals.lunch: Café Wayan — long-standing Ubud favourite with Indonesian and Western dishes in a garden setting
meals.dinner: Hujan Locale — modern Indonesian regional cuisine in a beautifully designed colonial-era building

day_by_day.notes: Museum combo tickets are available. Ubud Palace performances start around 19:30 — arrive 30 minutes early for good seats. Tickets ~IDR 100,000.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day beach excursion to Nusa Dua / Sanur (~1.5 hrs south). Morning swim and beach walk at Sanur Beach — calm, reef-protected waters ideal for swimming and snorkelling
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a bicycle in Sanur and cycle the scenic 5km beachfront path. Visit the Museum Le Mayeur (former home of Belgian painter Adrien-Jean Le Mayeur) for a cultural detour
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at a beachfront café in Sanur before returning to Ubud

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at hotel before departing
meals.lunch: Char Ming (Sanur) — charming French-Balinese fusion in a garden villa, mid-range pricing
meals.dinner: Warung Mak Beng (Sanur) — legendary local spot famous for simple, perfectly grilled fish; very affordable and iconic

day_by_day.notes: Sanur is calmer and more family-oriented than Kuta — great for relaxed beach time. Bicycle rentals available along the beachfront path for ~IDR 30,000/hr.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn departure for Mount Batur sunrise trek (~2 hrs from Ubud). Guided hike to the summit (1,717m) arriving for a spectacular sunrise over the caldera and Lake Batur — one of Bali's most rewarding experiences
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend the volcano and soak tired muscles in natural hot springs at Toya Devasya Hot Springs on the shores of Lake Batur
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud, rest, and enjoy a gentle evening walk along Campuhan Ridge at dusk

meals.breakfast: Packed breakfast provided by the guide at the summit (eggs cooked in volcanic steam — a classic!)
meals.lunch: Light meal at Toya Devasya Hot Springs café
meals.dinner: Room service or a quiet dinner at Bridges Bali — treat yourself after the big day

day_by_day.notes: Book a licensed guide in advance (~IDR 300,000–400,000 per person including transport). Depart hotel by 02:00–03:00am. Bring a warm layer — summit temperatures can drop to 10°C. Sturdy shoes essential.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the Batur trek. Gentle restorative yoga session at the hotel or Yoga Barn. Optional: book a traditional Balinese boreh (herbal body scrub) treatment at a local spa
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Traditional Market in the afternoon (less crowded than morning) and wander through the artisan village of Celuk (silverwork) and Mas (woodcarving) ~20 min south of Ubud
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening in Campuhan — sit by the river with a book and enjoy the sounds of the jungle

meals.breakfast: Sari Organik — return visit for their famous organic smoothies and eggs benedict
meals.lunch: Warung Pulau Kelapa (Ubud) — Javanese-style dishes in a beautiful garden setting, very affordable
meals.dinner: Kebun Bistro (Ubud) — charming garden bistro with Indonesian and international dishes, candle-lit tables

day_by_day.notes: This is an intentional rest day — don't over-schedule. Listen to your body after the volcano trek. Book any remaining spa treatments today for the rest of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Amed Beach on Bali's east coast (~2 hrs from Ubud). Morning snorkelling at the famous Japanese shipwreck just offshore — crystal-clear waters with vibrant coral and marine life
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Amed's traditional fishing village, observe jukung (outrigger boats) being built and painted. Relax on the black-sand beach and enjoy the dramatic views of Mount Agung
day_by_day.evening: Sunset from Amed's beachfront before driving back to Ubud (or consider an overnight stay for a slower pace)

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel before departure
meals.lunch: Wawa Wewe II Restaurant (Amed) — fresh grilled seafood right on the beach, affordable and delicious
meals.dinner: Café Indus (Ubud) — stylish open-air restaurant with stunning rice terrace views and refined Indonesian dishes

day_by_day.notes: Hire a private driver for this trip (~IDR 500,000–600,000). Rent snorkel gear locally in Amed (~IDR 50,000). The drive through Sidemen valley is scenic — ask the driver to take this route.

day_by_day.morning: Morning vinyasa flow yoga class followed by a sound healing or meditation session at Yoga Barn — a deeply restorative mid-trip ritual
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Pura Luhur Batukaru temple (~1.5 hrs west of Ubud) — one of Bali's most sacred and atmospheric temples, nestled in misty mountain jungle. Then explore the beautiful Jatiluwih Rice Terraces (UNESCO World Heritage) nearby
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud for a cooking class dinner experience — learn to make 4–5 traditional Balinese dishes with a local chef

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — specialty coffee and a hearty breakfast to fuel the day
meals.lunch: Local warung near Jatiluwih — simple nasi campur with a view of the terraces
meals.dinner: Dinner IS the cooking class — enjoy the fruits of your labour! (Book through Paon Bali Cooking Class or Casa Luna Cooking School)

day_by_day.notes: Batukaru temple requires a sarong — usually provided at the entrance. Jatiluwih has a small entrance fee (~IDR 40,000). Cooking classes run ~3–4 hours and cost ~IDR 350,000–500,000 per person.

day_by_day.morning: Final beach day — head to Balangan Beach or Bingin Beach (~1.5 hrs south) in the Bukit Peninsula. These cliff-backed white-sand beaches are among Bali's most beautiful and less crowded in July
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk the clifftop path between Bingin and Impossibles Beach, enjoy the turquoise water views. Optional: book a surf lesson at Bingin (consistent waves for intermediate surfers)
day_by_day.evening: Farewell sunset cocktails at Single Fin (Uluwatu) — a legendary clifftop bar with sweeping Indian Ocean views, live music, and a great atmosphere

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at hotel before departure
meals.lunch: Thomas Beach Café (Bingin) — fresh wraps, smoothie bowls, and cold Bintangs right on the beach
meals.dinner: Naughty Nuri's Warung (Ubud) — back in Ubud for legendary BBQ pork ribs and signature martinis — a Bali institution for a farewell dinner

day_by_day.notes: The Bukit cliffs require some walking down steep steps to reach the beaches — wear good sandals. Arrive at Single Fin by 17:30 for the best sunset spots. This is a full and celebratory final full day.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise Campuhan Ridge Walk — a peaceful, reflective last morning stroll through the misty green hills. Pack in any last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Market
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of hotel, transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for the drive and check-in
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Bali

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at the hotel — savour it!
meals.lunch: Quick meal at Ubud before departure or at the airport (Biku or a local warung near the hotel)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your flight departure time and factor in Bali's unpredictable traffic — especially on the Ubud–airport road during afternoon hours. Leave hotel no later than 3 hours before your flight. Don't forget to declare any wooden items or food products at customs.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay. Upon arrival, enjoy a welcome drink and resort orientation. Freshen up and take a gentle introductory stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk to soak in the lush green hillside scenery and settle into the Ubud ambiance.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on the hotel terrace overlooking the ridge, followed by a relaxing welcome dinner at the hotel's in-house restaurant or a short ride to Bridges Bali, a renowned fine-dining restaurant perched above the Campuhan River.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight or airport
meals.lunch: Light arrival snack or welcome refreshments at the resort
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali — contemporary European-Asian fusion cuisine with dramatic river gorge views; reserve the terrace table for a premium experience

day_by_day.notes: Request early check-in in advance. Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Luggage storage available at the resort if room isn't ready immediately upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a 90-minute sunrise yoga session on the resort's open-air yoga pavilion overlooking the Campuhan Ridge. Follow with a nourishing organic breakfast at the hotel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided walk along Campuhan Ridge Walk continuing into Bangkiang Sidem village. Explore local artisan workshops and rice terrace paths. Return to the resort for a 60-minute traditional Balinese massage at the spa.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Ubud's vibrant Jalan Raya Ubud. Visit the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) for the nightly Kecak fire dance performance, a mesmerizing cultural spectacle.

meals.breakfast: Organic buffet breakfast at the resort — tropical fruits, Balinese black rice porridge, freshly pressed juices
meals.lunch: Sari Organik — a beloved farm-to-table restaurant nestled in the rice fields near Ubud, accessible by a scenic walk
meals.dinner: Locavore — one of Bali's most acclaimed fine-dining restaurants in Ubud; book well in advance; tasting menu with locally sourced Indonesian ingredients

day_by_day.notes: Kecak dance at Ubud Palace typically starts at 19:30; book tickets in advance through the concierge. Bring a light shawl for the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Private Hatha yoga and pranayama session at Radiantly Alive Yoga Studio in central Ubud — one of Bali's premier yoga centers. Choose from their premium class schedule or arrange a private session.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple (Holy Spring Temple) for a purification water blessing ritual — a deeply spiritual and authentic Balinese experience. Continue to the Tegallalang Rice Terraces for photography and exploration.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a private couples' or solo sunset spa ritual — Balinese boreh body scrub followed by a flower bath. Dinner at leisure in Ubud.

meals.breakfast: À la carte breakfast at the resort — avocado toast, nasi goreng, fresh coconut
meals.lunch: Swept Away at COMO Uma Ubud — elegant open-air dining surrounded by jungle; international and Indonesian cuisine
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — Ubud's legendary fine-dining institution; French-influenced tasting menus with Balinese ingredients; wine pairing available

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for Tirta Empul (sarong provided at the temple). Bring a change of clothes if participating in the purification ritual. Tegallalang is best visited before 16:00 to avoid tour groups.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and meditation session on Campuhan Ridge with a personal instructor — watch the morning mist lift over the jungle valley. Follow with a healthy smoothie bowl breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum, a spectacular hillside gallery celebrating the work of Spanish-Balinese artist Don Antonio Blanco. Explore Ubud Art Market for premium handcrafted souvenirs and textiles. Stroll through Monkey Forest Sanctuary.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Legong dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud. Afterward, enjoy a private candlelit dinner arranged by the resort in a secluded garden setting.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowls, granola, and tropical fruits at the resort's garden terrace
meals.lunch: Room4Dessert — avant-garde dessert-focused tasting experience by chef Will Goldfarb; a unique culinary adventure
meals.dinner: Private in-resort candlelit dinner — arranged by the hotel with a curated Balinese menu; premium local wine or cocktails

day_by_day.notes: Monkey Forest requires closed-toe shoes or sandals with straps. Do not carry visible food near the monkeys. Legong dance performances vary by venue — ask concierge for the best evening show.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to Seminyak and Kerobokan beaches on Bali's southwestern coast (approx. 1.5-hour private transfer). Morning beach yoga session on the sand at Seminyak Beach with a private instructor.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the pristine shores of Seminyak Beach. Arrange a premium sun lounger and beach butler service at Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club. Enjoy ocean swimming in the warm Indian Ocean waters.
day_by_day.evening: Iconic Seminyak sunset at Ku De Ta Beach Club — world-famous for its golden hour atmosphere. Dinner in Seminyak's upscale dining district before private transfer back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before departure
meals.lunch: Merah Putih — sophisticated modern Indonesian cuisine in a stunning architectural space in Seminyak
meals.dinner: Sarong Restaurant, Seminyak — award-winning Southeast Asian cuisine in an intimate setting; signature cocktails and extensive wine list

day_by_day.notes: July weather in Seminyak is ideal — minimal rain, warm temperatures around 25°C, and gentle surf. Book beach club reservations in advance. Private driver for the day is recommended — arrange through the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Morning Vinyasa flow yoga class at the resort followed by a guided meditation walk through the Campuhan Ridge jungle path with a local spiritual guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private cooking class at a premium Ubud cooking school — learn to prepare traditional Balinese dishes including lawar, satay lilit, and black rice pudding using ingredients sourced from a local organic market visit.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the atmospheric Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the confluence of two rivers near the resort. Quiet evening stroll through Campuhan village.

meals.breakfast: Full Balinese breakfast at the resort — jamu turmeric tonic, rice porridge, fresh tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes prepared during the cooking class as part of the experience
meals.dinner: Alaya Resort Ubud's Plantation Restaurant — refined Indonesian cuisine in a lush open-air setting with live acoustic music

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class typically includes a morning market visit, so coordinate timing with the resort. Pura Gunung Lebah is especially serene in the early evening — bring a sarong.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise trekking experience to Mount Batur volcano (Kintamani region, approx. 1.5-hour drive). Guided summit hike beginning at 04:00 to catch the sunrise above the clouds — a bucket-list Bali experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by midday. Enjoy a well-deserved 2-hour rejuvenating spa package — hot stone massage, Balinese reflexology, and herbal steam.
day_by_day.evening: Quiet, restorative evening at the resort. Gentle yin yoga session followed by a nourishing dinner.

meals.breakfast: Pre-packed gourmet snack box provided by the resort for the early morning trek; hot breakfast upon return
meals.lunch: Light healthy lunch at the resort — salads, fresh juices, and Balinese soups
meals.dinner: Kafe Batan Waru — a long-standing Ubud favorite offering authentic Indonesian regional specialties in a warm, intimate setting

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur trek requires an early 03:00–03:30 departure. Arrange a private guide and transport through the resort. Bring layers — the summit can be cool at 1,717m elevation. Trekking poles are recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Restorative morning — gentle sunrise yoga and breathwork on the resort terrace. Leisurely breakfast with no fixed schedule to allow full recovery from the Batur trek.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Agung Rai Museum of Art (ARMA) — one of Bali's finest art museums featuring classical and contemporary Balinese works. Explore the museum's extensive jungle gardens. Attend an optional traditional painting or batik workshop.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the spectacular Kecak and Fire Dance at the clifftop Uluwatu Temple (approx. 1.5-hour drive) — one of Bali's most dramatic cultural performances at sunset above the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Extended à la carte breakfast at the resort — eggs benedict, smoked salmon, Balinese herbal teas
meals.lunch: ARMA Resort Restaurant — elegant open-air dining within the museum complex; Indonesian and international cuisine
meals.dinner: Single Fin, Uluwatu — iconic clifftop restaurant and bar with panoramic ocean views; international menu; perfect post-Kecak dinner

day_by_day.notes: Uluwatu Temple Kecak performance starts at approximately 18:00. Sarong required at the temple. Watch belongings near monkeys at Uluwatu. Book transport and dinner reservations in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga session on the ridge followed by a visit to a traditional Balinese healer (Balian) — a unique wellness and spiritual experience deeply rooted in Balinese Hindu culture. Arrange through the resort concierge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the hidden waterfall of Nungnung or Tegenungan Waterfall (closer to Ubud) — a refreshing natural escape. Private guided nature walk through the surrounding jungle.
day_by_day.evening: Premium sunset cocktail experience at the resort terrace. Indulge in a private in-villa dining experience arranged by the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter, overnight oats, and herbal jamu shots at the resort
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch arranged by the resort and enjoyed at the waterfall site — gourmet sandwiches, fruit, and chilled beverages
meals.dinner: In-resort private dining — chef's special Balinese tasting menu served in your villa or garden; paired with Balinese arak cocktails or imported wine

day_by_day.notes: Tegenungan Waterfall is closer and easier to access; Nungnung is more remote but more dramatic. Wear water shoes. The Balian healer session is deeply personal — approach with openness and respect.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to Nusa Lembongan island (approx. 2-hour drive to Sanur + 30-minute fast boat). Morning snorkeling or scuba diving at the world-class Manta Point — swim with majestic manta rays in crystal-clear waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Nusa Lembongan's pristine beaches — Mushroom Bay and Dream Beach. Relax at a beachside luxury day club. Optional paddleboarding or kayaking in the turquoise lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at a clifftop bar on Nusa Lembongan before taking the fast boat back to Sanur and private transfer to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before departure
meals.lunch: Sandy Bay Beach Club, Nusa Lembongan — premium beachside dining with fresh seafood, cocktails, and stunning ocean views
meals.dinner: Hujan Locale, Ubud — innovative Indonesian regional cuisine by acclaimed chef Will Meyrick; a must-visit culinary experience

day_by_day.notes: Book fast boat tickets and diving/snorkeling tours in advance through the resort. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a rash guard, and waterproof bag. Return boat typically departs by 17:00.

day_by_day.morning: Immersive morning yoga retreat experience at The Yoga Barn — Ubud's iconic wellness center. Choose from a premium workshop: Kundalini yoga, sound healing, or aerial yoga. Follow with a visit to the on-site organic café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Luxurious full-afternoon spa journey at COMO Shambhala Estate — one of Asia's most prestigious wellness retreats. Enjoy a signature treatment combining Ayurvedic principles with Balinese healing techniques.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell pre-dinner cocktails at the resort terrace. Elegant dinner at one of Ubud's finest restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast at The Yoga Barn's Garden Kafe — acai bowls, green smoothies, vegan options
meals.lunch: COMO Shambhala Estate — health-focused gourmet cuisine in a stunning jungle setting; organic, locally sourced ingredients
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert or Locavore (second visit for a different tasting menu) — Ubud's pinnacle fine-dining experiences

day_by_day.notes: COMO Shambhala Estate requires advance booking for spa treatments. The Yoga Barn offers a variety of class styles — check their schedule and book premium workshops early.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga and meditation session on Campuhan Ridge — a meaningful ritual to close the wellness journey. Mindful journaling and reflection time in the resort garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure afternoon for personal exploration or last-minute shopping at Ubud's premium boutiques — Kou Cuisine, Ganesha Bookshop, and artisan galleries along Jalan Hanoman. Optional final spa treatment at the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Special farewell dinner at a top-tier Ubud restaurant with the full Balinese experience — live gamelan music, traditional dance, and ceremonial cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory full breakfast at the resort — champagne, tropical fruits, and a Balinese feast spread
meals.lunch: Naughty Nuri's Warung — legendary Ubud institution famous for its BBQ pork ribs and martinis; a beloved local classic
meals.dinner: Indus Restaurant, Campuhan — beautiful open-air restaurant with panoramic ridge views; Pan-Asian cuisine and excellent cocktail menu; perfect farewell dinner location near the resort

day_by_day.notes: Pack the night before to allow a relaxed final morning. Confirm departure transfer time with the resort. Check for any last-minute Ubud cultural ceremonies — July often features temple festivals.

day_by_day.morning: Final gentle morning walk along Campuhan Ridge at dawn — a peaceful goodbye to Ubud's magical landscape. Return for a leisurely checkout breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Allow 2–2.5 hours for the journey depending on traffic. Enjoy the resort's premium departure amenities — packed snacks, chilled towels, and a farewell gift.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Bali — carry the memories of 13 extraordinary days of beaches, yoga, culture, and luxury.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at the resort — order your favorite dishes from the trip; savor the last tropical morning
meals.lunch: Airport dining or pre-departure snack box prepared by the resort
meals.dinner: In-flight

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout if your flight allows — the resort may accommodate until 14:00. Confirm airport transfer at least one day prior. Bali airport duty-free offers excellent local coffee, chocolate, and crafts for last-minute gifts.
